intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Crafted with strength, styled with purpose
features.text: Our engineered wood frame offers long-lasting support while blending seamlessly into your space with clean lines and enduring quality.

features.title: Hydraulic storage that simplifies life
features.text: With spacious lift-up compartments beneath, you can store away all your extras — keeping your space tidy, functional, and effortlessly organised. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Cushioned comfort for every moment
features.text: The soft, padded headboard offers a supportive rest for lazy mornings, evening reads, or a quiet cup of tea.

features.title: Matte finish that adds gentle texture
features.text: The wood’s textured surface introduces a soft, natural feel that warms up your room without overpowering your style.

features.title: Smart storage, built right into the headboard
features.text: With handy compartments and a sleek ledge, your go-to items — like books or glasses — are always close, and your space remains beautifully arranged.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
